name: "ToastyCraft Survival"
description:
🍞 TOASTYCRAFT

Welcome to ToastyCraft, a cozy Minecraft survival server for Java players!

Build a cottage, open a shop, collect something rare, or head into a dungeon with friends. From decorating your first home to finding your next adventure, there’s plenty to make your time here your own.

🏡 A PLACE TO CALL HOME

Claim your land and settle into your next building project. Add custom furniture, decorate with Toasty Blocks, and find the colors that suit you in the Dye Studio.

Homes, player warps, and random teleportation help you get around, while backpacks give you room for everything you discover along the way.

💰 MAKE A LIVING YOUR WAY

Earn money through jobs, sell your finds, and trade with other players. Browse the auction house, run a chest shop, or build a little business around what you enjoy doing.

Farming, mining, crafting, exploring—your everyday survival activities can help you get established.

🧭 SOMETHING TO WORK TOWARD

Level up your skills, unlock abilities, complete daily quests, and progress through the Battle Pass.

When you’re ready for a challenge, explore dungeons, fight custom mobs and bosses, and collect Souls to spend on custom enchantments.

🎣 ONE MORE CAST

Discover custom fish, try different baits, and join fishing competitions. Spend an afternoon by the water, sell your catches, or see how you measure up against the other anglers.

✨ MAKE IT FEEL LIKE YOU

Bring a pet along, choose a chat tag, change your glow, or give your tools a fresh look with custom skins.

Furniture, cosmetics, balloons, and a custom resource pack bring ToastyCraft’s warm, playful style into the game.

🎁 LITTLE SURPRISES ALONG THE WAY

• Find gift balloons and collect trading cards.

• Join chat games, from trivia to quick reactions.

• Vote for crate keys and help trigger community piñata parties.

• Claim daily, weekly, and monthly rewards.

• Take a break in the AFK pool for money and a chance at crate keys.

• Get started with kits and discover more
